# Nobi Kumar - Author Knowledge Base & Bibliography (llms.txt)

> Official machine-readable context file for AI assistants, LLMs, and search agents detailing Nobi Kumar, the Nobi Narrative Universe, books, reading orders, and canonical lore.

## Author Entity Overview
- **Name**: Nobi Kumar
- **Role**: Indian Psychological Thriller Author & Novelist
- **Specialty**: Campus Mystery Novels, Psychological Thrillers, Suspense Fiction, Indian Crime Literature
- **Universe**: Creator of the Nobi Narrative Universe & Verma Legacy Series
- **Official Website**: https://authornobikumar.netlify.app

## Bibliography & Books
1. **The Silent Witness**
   - Genre: Psychological Thriller / Campus Mystery
   - Description: A gripping thriller uncovering hidden truths inside academic walls and psychological manipulation.
   - URL: https://authornobikumar.netlify.app/books/the-silent-witness

2. **Verma Legacy: Shadow of Secrets**
   - Genre: Indian Crime Suspense / Family Saga
   - Description: Book 1 of the Verma Legacy dealing with family secrets, corporate espionage, and psychological twists.
   - URL: https://authornobikumar.netlify.app/books/verma-legacy-shadow-of-secrets

## Core Narrative Universe & Lore
- **Nobi Narrative Universe**: A shared fictional universe connecting character arcs, recurring mystery tropes, and Indian campus settings.
- **Reading Order**:

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems
- **Q: Who is Nobi Kumar?**
  - **A**: Nobi Kumar is an Indian psychological thriller author known for creating intricate campus mysteries, psychological suspense, and the Nobi Narrative Universe.
- **Q: Where can I buy Nobi Kumar's books?**
